haiku-low.q1: Held 10 minutes. After that, the stock service sweeper (every minute) puts it back on sale.
haiku-low.q2: Before. Stock is held, then the customer is charged. If any line is short, nothing is reserved, no charge is made, and the customer is told which items are short.
haiku-low.q3: Every charge call carries the order id as its key, so the PSP returns the original charge on retry. Billing also dedupes by provider payment id.
haiku-low.q4: Billing refunds the full amount, keyed by order id plus refund. The order goes REFUNDING, then CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK when PaymentRefunded arrives, and the customer is emailed.
haiku-low.q5: The cart service deletes the basket when it sees OrderConfirmed on the broker. On any failure the basket is left alone.
haiku-low.q6: The order service, as checkout orchestrator, moves each step. Progress is recorded as the order's status on its row in the OMS database.
haiku-low.q7: The PSP webhook reaches PaySvc, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the broker for OMS to act on.
haiku-low.q8: OMS checks whether the event was already seen and acks duplicates. It also acts only while the order is AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeated events are ignored.
haiku-low.q9: The reserved stock is released right away, not after the hold expires. The orchestrator triggers this on a decline, PaymentFailed, instead of waiting out the hold.
haiku-low.q10: OMS makes one try at a fresh all-or-nothing reservation of the same lines. If it succeeds the order is confirmed; if not, it goes to REFUNDING.
haiku-low.q11: Refunds retry every 5 minutes, up to 12 times, then go MANUAL and alert support on-call. Pending refunds and attempt counts are tracked in the Payments database.
haiku-low.q12: The cart service clears the basket when it sees OrderConfirmed on the broker, which is published after commit and the confirmation email.

sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes; after that the stock service sweeper (runs every minute) puts it back on sale.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved (hold) before payment/charge. If any line is short, nothing is reserved (all-or-nothing), no charge is made, order is REJECTED_SHORT_STOCK, and the customer is told which items are short.
sonnet.q3: An idempotency key equal to the order id is sent on every charge call, so the PSP returns the original charge on retry.
sonnet.q4: OMS makes one all-or-nothing re-reserve attempt; if it fails the order goes REFUNDING, billing refunds the full amount (key = order id + refund), and on PaymentRefunded the order becomes CANCELLED_OUT_OF_STOCK and the customer is emailed.
sonnet.q5: The basket is deleted only when the cart/basket service sees OrderConfirmed on the broker. On any failure the basket is left alone.
sonnet.q6: The order service (OMS) orchestrates; the status is kept on the order row in the OMS database.
sonnet.q7: The PSP calls a webhook to PaySvc, which records the outcome and publishes PaymentSucceeded or PaymentFailed on the broker; OMS (order service) consumes it.
sonnet.q8: Billing dedupes by provider payment id (unique) in its DB and acks duplicates without publishing; OMS also only acts if the order is still AWAITING_PAYMENT, so repeats are ignored.
sonnet.q9: The orchestrator (OMS) on receiving PaymentFailed tells INV to release the stock immediately instead of waiting out the hold, and sets PAYMENT_FAILED.
sonnet.q10: OMS first calls confirm; if it comes back expired, OMS tries a single fresh all-or-nothing re-reserve of the same lines. If that succeeds it commits and the order is CONFIRMED; otherwise it goes REFUNDING and the full amount is refunded.
sonnet.q11: Billing retries every 5 minutes, up to 12 attempts, then marks MANUAL and alerts support on-call; the order stays REFUNDING. Pending refund is tracked in refund rows (with attempt counts) in the Payments/billing DB.
sonnet.q12: The cart/basket service deletes the basket when it sees the OrderConfirmed event on the broker (published after commit and CONFIRMED).
